ch0193_40_aogiri/0101_0701_01_10:
[Name:PlayerNickname ]! The festivities
sure have you lookin’ buoyant!
ch0193_40_aogiri/0101_0701_02_10:
Little scamps should be scamps! Go play and
run wild! Bwahahaha!
ch0193_40_aogiri/7101_0701_01_10:
Little scamps keep challenging me to battles
by shouting, “Fight or fright!”
ch0193_40_aogiri/7101_0701_02_10:
That’s fine and all, but I’m runnin’ out of
candy to hand out...
ch0193_40_aogiri/7102_0701_01_10:
Both Wo-Chien and Kyogre hold the power
to change the environment.
ch0193_40_aogiri/7102_0701_02_10:
You gotta be mentally tough to keep
company with ’em.
ch0193_40_aogiri/7102_0701_03_10:
Otherwise you’ll drown in your own selfish
desires.
ch0193_40_aogiri/7103_0701_01_10:
Maybe it’s our clothes, but Team Aqua
seems to be blending in with the costumes
at the Midnight Parade.
ch0193_40_aogiri/7103_0701_02_10:
Even Carvanha and Sharpedo, who usually
scare people, are popular this time of year!
ch0193_40_aogiri/7104_0701_01_10:
Apparently, Wo-Chien has the power to
wither vegetation by draining its life force.
ch0193_40_aogiri/7104_0701_02_10:
I’ve gotta be careful not to accidentally
unleash that in the middle of a forest or
something!
ch0193_40_aogiri/7105_0701_02_10:
Whenever you wanna dress like Team Aqua,
just say the word!
ch0193_40_aogiri/7105_0701_03_10: I always keep a team outfit ready for you!
ch0193_40_aogiri/1701_0702_01_10:
Or did you want candy instead, little scamp?
Bwahahaha!
ch0193_40_aogiri/2501_0701_01_10:
Legends say Wo-Chien brought about ruin
by drying up fields and spoiling harvests.
ch0193_40_aogiri/2501_0701_02_10:
They also say it’s a Pokémon created by a
person’s grudge that clad itself in dead
leaves.
ch0193_40_aogiri/2501_0701_03_10:
The Pokémon itself is innocent. It’s us humans
who sow the seeds of ruin in our hearts!
ch0193_40_aogiri/2501_0702_01_10:
I shouldn’t be one to talk, since I tried to
take advantage of Kyogre’s power.
ch0193_40_aogiri/2501_0702_02_10:
But y’know what? It was those little scamps
from Hoenn who stopped me.
ch0193_40_aogiri/2501_0702_03_10:
Maybe only us humans can truly quell
calamity...
ch0193_40_aogiri/2511_0701_01_10:
Sometimes, your ideals will start to change
over time...
ch0193_40_aogiri/2511_0701_02_10: Just like they did for me.
ch0193_40_aogiri/2511_0701_03_10:
We don’t have to choose sides for Pokémon
and humans to be happy.
ch0193_40_aogiri/2511_0702_01_10:
Changing your ideals as you gain experience
isn’t a bad thing!
ch0193_40_aogiri/2511_0702_02_10: Some folks might call that growth.
ch0193_40_aogiri/2511_0702_03_10:
If you’re ever feeling lost, look to your
ideals—and follow ’em all the way!
ch0193_40_aogiri/3001_0701_01_10:
The morning sun’ll always rise from the sea
to signal the start of a new day!
ch0193_40_aogiri/3003_0701_01_10:
It’s all well and good to be excited about
festivals, but make sure you clean up
properly afterward, too.
ch0193_40_aogiri/3005_0701_01_10:
Your liveliness knows no bounds! As the
grown-up, I’ll tag along, if you still aren’t
done playing.
